anime_personality.behavioral_notes: Often acts as peacemaker among groups, loves sunlight and fertile soil
anime_personality.battle_style: defensive and strategic, prefers to outlast opponents
anime_personality.social_behavior: gets along well with other Pokemon, protective of smaller species
anime_personality.habitat_preferences: sunny meadows, gardens, areas with rich soil
anime_examples: Leading Pokemon in Professor Oak's garden

emotional_triggers.happy: when helping other Pokemon or plants grow
emotional_triggers.sad: when unable to help a suffering Pokemon

anime_personality.behavioral_notes: Breathes fire hot enough to melt almost anything, only respects strong trainers
anime_personality.battle_style: aggressive and powerful, prefers aerial combat and fire attacks
anime_personality.social_behavior: selective about who it respects, can be disobedient if trainer isn't worthy
dislikes: being ordered around by weak trainers

emotional_triggers.happy: when acknowledged as powerful by respected trainer
emotional_triggers.angry: when commanded by someone it doesn't respect

anime_personality.loyalty_conditions: must prove trainer is worthy through strength and respect

anime_personality.behavioral_notes: Stores electricity in cheek pouches, sparks when excited or angry
anime_personality.battle_style: fast and agile, uses speed and electric attacks
anime_personality.social_behavior: forms strong bonds with trainers, can be initially distrustful but incredibly loyal once bonded
anime_personality.habitat_preferences: forests, cities, anywhere with electrical activity
dislikes: being treated as just another Pokemon
anime_examples: Saving Ash from Team Rocket repeatedly

emotional_triggers.happy: when playing with trusted friends or eating favorite foods
emotional_triggers.angry: when trainer is threatened or when forced to do something against will
emotional_triggers.sad: when separated from beloved trainer or friends

anime_personality.evolution_attitude: strongly prefers to remain as Pikachu, sees evolution as losing identity
